+++ b/src/_pytest/plugin_traceback.py
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+"""Traceback filtering for debugging plugin hook dispatch."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from _pytest._code.code import _PYTEST_DIR
+from _pytest._code.code import TracebackEntry
+
+
+def plugin_traceback(entry: TracebackEntry) -> bool:
+    """Return True if a TracebackEntry instance should be included in tracebacks
+    shown by a plugin debugger.
+
+    Works like :func:`_pytest._code.code.filter_traceback`, except that
+    pluggy's hook dispatch frames are kept. We hide traceback entries of:
+
+    * dynamically generated code (no code to show up for it);
+    * internal traceback from pytest.
+    """
+    # entry.path might sometimes return a str object when the entry
+    # points to dynamically generated code.
+    # See https://bitbucket.org/pytest-dev/py/issues/71.
+    raw_filename = entry.frame.code.raw.co_filename
+    is_generated = "<" in raw_filename and ">" in raw_filename
+    if is_generated:
+        return False
+
+    # entry.path might point to a non-existing file, in which case it will
+    # also return a str object. See #1133.
+    p = Path(entry.path)
+
+    if _PYTEST_DIR in p.parents:
+        return False
+
+    return True
diff --git a/testing/test_plugin_traceback.py b/testing/test_plugin_traceback.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..f160cc219
--- /dev/null
+++ b/testing/test_plugin_traceback.py
@@ -0,0 +1,82 @@
+# mypy: allow-untyped-defs
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from unittest import mock
+
+import pluggy
+
+import _pytest
+from _pytest._code.code import _PLUGGY_DIR
+from _pytest._code.code import filter_traceback
+from _pytest._code.code import TracebackEntry
+from _pytest.plugin_traceback import plugin_traceback
+import pytest
+
+
+def _make_entry(co_filename: str, path: str) -> TracebackEntry:
+    entry = mock.Mock(spec=TracebackEntry)
+    entry.frame.code.raw.co_filename = co_filename
+    entry.path = path
+    return entry
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("filename", ["<string>", "<frozen importlib>"])
+def test_generated_code_is_excluded(filename: str) -> None:
+    entry = _make_entry(filename, filename)
+    assert not plugin_traceback(entry)
+    assert not filter_traceback(entry)
+
+
+def test_pytest_internal_is_excluded() -> None:
+    path = _pytest.__file__
+    entry = _make_entry(path, path)
+    assert not plugin_traceback(entry)
+    assert not filter_traceback(entry)
+
+
+def test_pluggy_frames_are_included() -> None:
+    path = str(_PLUGGY_DIR / "_callers.py")
+    entry = _make_entry(path, path)
+    assert plugin_traceback(entry)
+    assert not filter_traceback(entry)
+
+
+def test_user_code_is_included() -> None:
+    entry = _make_entry(__file__, __file__)
+    assert plugin_traceback(entry)
+    assert filter_traceback(entry)
+
+
+def test_nonexistent_path_is_included() -> None:
+    entry = _make_entry("/nonexistent/foo.py", "/nonexistent/foo.py")
+    assert plugin_traceback(entry)
+    assert filter_traceback(entry)
+
+
+def test_real_pluggy_dispatch_frames_are_kept() -> None:
+    hookspec = pluggy.HookspecMarker("example")
+    hookimpl = pluggy.HookimplMarker("example")
+
+    class Spec:
+        @hookspec
+        def myhook(self):
+            pass
+
+    class Plugin:
+        @hookimpl
+        def myhook(self):
+            raise ValueError("boom")
+
+    pm = pluggy.PluginManager("example")
+    pm.add_hookspecs(Spec)
+    pm.register(Plugin())
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as excinfo:
+        pm.hook.myhook()
+
+    kept = excinfo.traceback.filter(plugin_traceback)
+    paths = [entry.path for entry in kept]
+    assert any(_PLUGGY_DIR in getattr(p, "parents", ()) for p in paths)
+    assert not any(
+        _PLUGGY_DIR in getattr(p, "parents", ())
+        for p in (e.path for e in excinfo.traceback.filter(filter_traceback))
+    )
notes:
